results.question: How are sales doing?
results.sql:
WITH refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS refunded_cents
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', o.placed_at)::date AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
  ROUND(SUM(o.subtotal_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS gross_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(o.discount_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS discounts,
  ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS shipping,
  ROUND(SUM(o.total_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refunded_cents), 0) / 100.0, 2) AS refunds,
  ROUND((SUM(o.total_cents) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refunded_cents), 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(o.total_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.placed_at)
ORDER BY month DESC;
